body.p: This Agreement for Legal Services is between [CLIENT NAME] (the “**Client**”) and The Silachi Law Firm, PLLC (the “**Firm**”). It sets out what the Firm will do, what it will not do, and what the representation costs.

body.text: The Firm will represent the Client in [MATTER DESCRIPTION]. The representation includes the following:

body.sub: Investigation of the facts and review of the governing documents.
Preparation and service of written demands and correspondence.
Negotiation with the opposing party and its counsel.

body.text: The representation does not include an appeal, a separate lawsuit, or any matter not named in Section II.A. Those require a new written agreement.
The Client will pay the Firm [FEE TERMS]. The Firm bills in tenths of an hour and sends a statement each month.
The Client will deposit $[AMOUNT] (the “**Retainer**”) before work begins. The Firm holds the Retainer in trust and draws against it only for earned fees and incurred expenses.

bullets: tell the Firm the truth, including facts that hurt the Client's position;
keep every document, text message, and email that relates to the matter; and
respond to the Firm's requests within five business days.

body.p: Either party may end this Agreement by written notice. The Client remains responsible for fees earned and expenses incurred through the date of termination.

signature.attestation: The parties sign this Agreement to be effective on the date the Firm receives the Retainer.
